An aggregate regression without attribution is not actionable. When a metric is marked regressed, `compare_runs` attaches the list of individual cases whose scores moved beyond the tolerance on that metric (or lost it entirely), with baseline value, candidate value, and delta per case, sorted worst first (`_attribute_regressions`). The aggregate tells you groundedness collapsed; the attribution tells you it collapsed on the {{cmp.v3.groundedness.n_pairs}} answerable cases where the fluent style dropped citations. Per-case rows also carry a `failure` label, so the failure-count deltas (for example `ungrounded` {{cmp.v3.fail.ungrounded|signed}}) line up with the metric attribution.
